Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <w5384.3540$bX4....@dfw-read.news.verio.net>,


No.

Sabbat Rules Insert - Camarilla Membership Has Its Privileges

Only Camarilla vampires can:
- be Primogen or Princes.
- call Praxis Seizures, Justicar Retribution, Command of the
Harpies, or Masquerade Enforcement - the effect can target
any vampire
- call a vote to burn Elysium: The Arboretum or
Masquerade Enforcement
* - can be chosen as an Archon or Camarilla Exemplary
(however, all vampires suffer the effects of blocking them)
- can become Primogen using the Of Noble Blood card from the
Dark Sovereigns expansion, though any vampire may call the
action.

Independent and Sabbat vampires can only use these abilities
if they have a Writ of Acceptance from the Ancient Hearts expansion.

Carpe Noctem.

Lasombra

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <U1A84.18819$Mg.2...@c01read03-admin.service.talkway.com>,

Madman2001 <Mad...@madman.com> wrote:
>However, can non-Camarilla vampires (e.g. a Prisci or Bishop) vote on
>these matters?? Or can they just not CALL the vote??

No vampires are prohibited by default from voting on any vote. A card
such as Inner Circle (I can think of no others, but may be wrong) would
be required to do such.

It is, as you say, merely a prohibition of calling the vote or, in some
instances, being chosen as the recipient of such.

--
James Coupe

> such as Inner Circle (I can think of no others, but may be wrong)
> would be required to do such.

James is thinking of Closed Session not "Inner Circle" which
is a title, not a card.

> It is, as you say, merely a prohibition of calling the vote or,
> in some instances, being chosen as the recipient of such.

The cards/actions specificied in the Sabbat Rules Addendum only
prohibit who may call or benefit from the actions, not who may
vote in them.

In general, all vampires with votes may vote in all referendums
unless prohibited by specific card text like Cardinal Benediction
or Closed Session.

> a few other cards that could be really gross if they were held to be
> same (Covenant of Blood, frex). I think we also allow Sabbat
> vampires to call the vote to burn Elysium, but then, I'm not sure if
> its ever really come up.

'Non-Camarilla' is synonymous with "NOT" Camarilla.
As far as the game is concerned, any member of a "Non-Camarilla"
or Sabbat clan is 'Non-Camarilla' and may play cards as such.

Covenant of Blood makes more sense for the Sabbat to play
than it does for the Independent clans to play but that's
just my personal preference.

Yes, Writ of Acceptance works for Sabbat vampires.
